concepts.def: Region from which light has had time to reach us; current radius ~46 billion light-years.
Boundary beyond which the universe is unobservable due to finite light travel time.
Network of filaments and voids forming the 'cosmic web' on >100 Mpc scales.
Universe is homogeneous and isotropic on large scales - the foundation of Lambda-CDM.
Density at which the universe is geometrically flat; ~9 x 10^-27 kg/m^3.
Speculative ideas of multiple disconnected universes; outside present observational reach.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Life in the Universe — a core area of A-Level Astronomy.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Life in the Universe brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Life in the Universe.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
